label: No placebo
rationale: This is an observational diagnostic cohort with a case-control component, not a placebo-controlled treatment trial. The arms describe lumbar puncture, phenotyping, and blood/genetic analyses for ALS patients and controls, with no inactive or active-placebo comparator described.
